effort: MAX per host alias/profile documentation; legacy low suffix is not the current thinking pin
lowest_axis: freshness, historically lowest non-retired; no invented calibrated scalar

claims.before: No round-6 source ledgers or parent passage checks for the 24 fixed questions across twelve named existing early-civilization entries. Baseline hashes and zero-ledger count are persisted in baseline.json.
claims.after_required: Exactly 24 named question rows across all twelve assigned entries with actual entry assertions/locators and source attempts; at least six distinct newly retrieved directly relevant non-bibliographic passages across at least four entries, plus at least three parent re-fetches of directly relevant non-bibliographic passages. Relevant passage is keyed by source URL, locator and short excerpt, not raw duplicate row count. No requirement to inflate supported totals or force a source-access failure into resolution.
claims.no_harm: Historical ledgers/reports/examples/gates remain byte-identical; knowledge corrections append, never erase old bytes or markers. Metadata, tertiary retellings and edition substitutions cannot verify unread contents. Raw downloads stay ignored, no restricted-work redistribution, no canon/cultural-permission or promotion decisions. Run previous acceptance in a disposable copy without rewriting its historical receipt.

source_schema.rule: Two audits per assigned file, matching targets.json IDs and questions. source_url is a single public HTTP(S) URL; other sources/annotation in separate optional fields. Retrieved passage requires actual source text, locator and short quotation, not a search snippet, bibliography, TOC or metadata. Partial support does not verify an entire compound claim.

roles: One planner/connector, twelve source executor/scout/scribe scopes, two source reviewers, one critic; all explicitly operator-pinned to the same native Flash MAX route, rather than a claim of the generic fleet bucket assignment.
admission_rule: Judge every axis; admit only if F verifies and none is harmed. Source classifications, parent readings and worker reviews are author-side evidence, not independent promotion verification.
